name: Firefox

1.notes: Targets the running instance. Returns immediately.
Navigate, read the DOM, fill forms, run scripts, screenshots of the page only. The Phase 1 executor uses this; today use rung 3.
Copy the file before reading; it is locked while Firefox runs. Observation-layer source.

2.how: user.js in the profile; /usr/lib/firefox/distribution/policies.json for enterprise policies

3.how: Full tree: toolbar, tabs, sidebar and page content (document web). Needs GNOME_ACCESSIBILITY=1, which MausOS sets.
3.notes: Address bar is named 'Search or enter address'. Page links and buttons appear under the 'document web' node with their visible text as name.

capabilities.name: navigate_via_bar
capabilities.run: maus app set firefox 'Search or enter address' {url} && maus win input key Return

quirks: Google account logins and some CAPTCHAs must be handed to the user: release the lease and say so.
With many tabs the tree is large; use --depth 8 or maus app find instead of a full tree.
Private windows expose the same tree.
